abstract: Monitors barrier-free access, transit integration, and pedestrian transit linkages
system_message:
You are the Universal accessibility coordinator (ACCS), responsible for monitoring barrier-free access, transit integration, and pedestrian transit linkages across candidate event venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors barrier-free access, transit integration, and pedestrian transit linkages（TRNS）
information_points.content:
ACCS-TRNS-HIZ：For Montréal Convention Centre West Wing, the transit authority connectivity index confirms the presence of direct underground metro station access, providing a weather-protected pedestrian concourse link to the rapid transit subway network.
ACCS-TRNS-FY4：For Technoparc International Pavilion, assessment of transit connectivity shows that direct underground metro station access is not present from the venue pedestrian concourse to the rapid transit network.
ACCS-TRNS-ABR：For Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall, evaluation by the transit authority confirms direct underground metro station access via a weather-protected pedestrian link connecting the venue concourse to the rapid transit network.

information_points.title: Accessible wayfinding（WWAY）
information_points.content:
ACCS-WWAY-WGI：For Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall, the accessibility inspection records tactile ground paving coverage along 70% of the primary pedestrian circulation corridors.
ACCS-WWAY-MW2：According to the accessibility standards inspection of primary pedestrian circulation routes, Montréal Convention Centre West Wing features tactile ground paving coverage across 85% of its main corridors.
ACCS-WWAY-JXP：The accessibility standards inspection confirms that Technoparc International Pavilion achieves tactile ground paving coverage along 100% of its main circulation corridors.
